sloka: तद्बाणशतनिर्भिन्नं विदारितशिलातलम्।सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं निपपात गिरः शिरः ।। ६.७०.२२ ।।
transliteration: tadbāṇaśatanirbhinnaṁ vidāritaśilātalam।savisphuliṅgaṁ sajvālaṁ nipapāta giraḥ śiraḥ ।। 6.70.22 ।।

translations.english: Hit by hundreds of arrows, the mountain peak broke into pieces of stones like sparks and flames fell from it.
